title: Rethinking Radiomap Blind Prediction with Limited Environment and Configuration Representations
abstract: arXiv:2609.11255v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Radiomap blind prediction infers radiomaps from observable representations of the propagation environment and base station (BS) configuration without field measurements. These representations are inherently incomplete and cannot uniquely determine the target radiomap. Under squared loss, we identify the conditional-mean radiomap as the population-optimal deterministic target and decompose domain risk into target-approximation error and irreducible uncertainty. The train-test risk gap motivates propagation priors as cross-domain guidance, although their partial or simplified forms may bias the attainable predictor. We therefore propose RadioDecomp, which treats a prior-guided predictor as a correctable base and uses deterministic residual refinement to learn its remaining predictable discrepancy. tldr: 该论文提出RadioDecomp框架（实例化为RadioLSR），将传播先验引导的预测器作为可修正的基础，并通过确定性残差细化学习剩余的可预测差异，从而在环境和基站配置表示不完备的情况下提升无线地图盲预测的跨域泛化性能。
